# Masab Farooque, Full Stack Engineer

> Masab Farooque is a full stack engineer based in Islamabad, Pakistan. He is
> brought in as an external resource by product teams and agencies to build
> SaaS platforms, AI systems, data pipelines and full stack web applications
> end to end. 148 reviews at a 5.0 average from clients in 23 countries.
> Company names appear only under Experience.

## Experience

- [Chord.fm](https://chord.fm), Full Stack Engineer, June 2026 to present.
  Browser based audio and video editor for podcasters and creators. Built the
  Music Library panel from scratch, including waveform playback with click to
  seek.
- Skylight Studio, Full Stack Engineer, March 2026 to present. Next.js
  internal tooling platform for the Engineering Solutions team, including The
  Proposal Maker, an AI assisted tool that reads an RFP or email thread with
  Claude and drafts a branded proposal section by section.

## Background

Bachelor of Science in Computer Science, COMSATS University Islamabad, 2023,
finished after three internships and a six month full time job. Unity game
developer at 10Static Studios and fellow at Mindstorm Studios from 2020 to
2023. Won Best Mechanics at the Rookie Game Jam 2022, The Hustler Award at
Epiphany Games in 2020, and placed runner up at Developers Game Jam 2.0. SEO
Web Developer at PentaByteX from September 2024 to February 2025. Web
Developer at Fixels.nl from November 2025 to April 2026, where he shipped
[Javea Denia Rentals](https://www.javea-denia-rentals.com/) and
[FirstDeal.nl](https://firstdeal.nl), both taken from an empty repository to
paying users.

He works solo, not as an agency. Every project is designed, built and
deployed by him.

## Articles

Technical writing on migrating off WordPress, headless CMS architecture and
web performance.

- [Moving a WordPress site to Next.js without losing your rankings](https://masabfarooque.com/blog/wordpress-to-nextjs-migration):
  freezing URLs, building and testing a redirect map, porting SEO metadata,
  and verifying the move in Search Console.
- [Keep the WordPress editor, drop the WordPress front end](https://masabfarooque.com/blog/wordpress-as-headless-cms):
  running WordPress as a headless CMS behind Next.js, using the REST API or
  WPGraphQL, with on demand revalidation so publishing stays instant.
- [Why a headless CMS beats building on WordPress or Wix](https://masabfarooque.com/blog/headless-cms-vs-website-builders):
  the coupling problem, where page builders cost you, and the cases where a
  builder is still the right choice.
- [Core Web Vitals for content sites](https://masabfarooque.com/blog/core-web-vitals-for-content-sites):
  what LCP, INP and CLS each measure, and the specific Next.js changes that
  improve them.

## Capabilities

Full stack product build, AI systems and agents, data pipelines and
scraping, SaaS platforms with billing and multi tenancy, interfaces with
motion, performance and technical SEO. Also WordPress to Next.js migrations,
and setting WordPress up as a headless CMS behind a Next.js front end so
editors keep their existing workflow.

## Stack

TypeScript, Python, SQL, Next.js, React, Tailwind CSS, Framer Motion,
FastAPI, Node.js, NestJS, Celery, Redis, PostgreSQL, Supabase, DynamoDB,
MongoDB, AWS Lambda, API Gateway, S3, Docker, Stripe, Claude API, OpenAI,
Groq, LangChain, retrieval augmented generation.
